* '''PC-E1''' ([[Beilert Valance (Errata)]]): the errata card image (1 January 2025)<ref name="ht-438622f">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/438622f436e85060b7e9e20f5e2ebb1b95b4313c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual24-Light/large/beilertvalance.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual24-Light/large/beilertvalance.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/438622f436e85060b7e9e20f5e2ebb1b95b4313c 438622f] “Beilert and Jaxxon template fixes”, 1 January 2025.</ref> prints: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Once per game, may deploy Cyborg Construct on Valance from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.” '''What changed:''' The words of the game text are unchanged. It is a version of its own because the PC published a visibly different card image (Bill, 12 November 2026: every visible change on a PC image is its own version). The card image prints no errata mark.
